ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = main ] && printf '%s\n' "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" | head -n 1 | grep -q '^chore(main): release '; then exit 1; fi
buildCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = production ]; then DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED:-$DATABASE_URL}" pnpm db:migrate; fi && pnpm build
